description: Top pages, top referrers, top countries and device/browser split for a site over the given period.

days.description: Days to look back: 7, 30 or 90. Defaults to 30. Ignored when 'from'/'to' are set.

from.description: Range start, YYYY-MM-DD. Use together with 'to'.

site.description: Logly site ID (slug). Call logly_list_sites to discover it.

to.description: Range end, YYYY-MM-DD. Use together with 'from'.

name: logly_breakdown
